Nominal.description: Full detector geometry. Z endcap backgrounds rejected via fiducial Z cut. No statistical reduction.

Reduced.description: Relaxed geometry. Z endcap backgrounds rejected via SignalParticleSurface < 3 filter. Statistical reduction factor applied per component above reduction_threshold_mev. Represents shielding matching vd_1x8x14_3view_30deg_shielded: ~98% neutron reduction (all energies) and ~85% gamma reduction above 3.5 MeV.

Truncated.description: Truncated dataset. Z endcap backgrounds rejected via SignalParticleSurface < 3 filter. No statistical reduction.
